title: LA BAYADÈRE (Paris Opera Ballet 2026 – 2027)
synopsis:
Broadway Cinemas is proud to exclusively present the Paris Opera Ballet's spectacular 2026-2027 season! Kicking this season off are two world-renowned ballet classics coming straight to the big screen: Romeo and Juliet and Swan Lake.

 

In a dreamlike India where a magnificent elephant parades before the rajah's lavish palace and a golden idol follows a fan dance, the ballet tells the story of the ill-fated love between the warrior Solor and Nikiya, a sacred temple dancer.

 

Ballet in three acts.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk:
百老匯院線獨家呈獻：巴黎歌劇院芭蕾舞團全新2026-2027季度隆重登場！率先把兩部殿堂級的芭蕾舞蹈 ——《羅密歐與茱麗葉》及《天鵝湖》帶上大銀幕。


在一片如幻似真的印度國度裡，宏偉的大象在王公（Rajah）華麗的宮殿前巡遊，金色神像隨著扇舞登場。這齣芭蕾舞劇講述了戰士索羅（Solor）與妮基雅（Nikiya）一段注定悲劇收場的愛情故事。


這是一部三幕芭蕾舞劇。

cast: Dorothée Gilbert (Nikiya), Hugo Marchand (Solor), Roxane Stojanov (Gamzatti), Premières Danseuses, Premiers Danseurs, Corps de Ballet
